inv.desc_es:
Wall Estate Inmobiliaria les presenta, en exclusiva, este estupendo local de ciento dos metros construidos, en el barrio de “La Guindalera” cerca de las calles Francisco Silvela y Diego de León.
Es un local diseñado como vivienda, que tiene ventilación cruzada con un patio interior cerrado muy agradable y salida independiente del edificio a la calle.
Totalmente reformado de estilo moderno y con mucha luz natural, con suelo radiante y gas natural; consta de cocina integrada en el salón, dormitorio principal, baño completo con ducha y un aseo; con patio interior de uso y disfrute para la vivienda.
La cocina totalmente equipada con frigorífico, lavadora, lavavajillas y cocina.
inv.desc_en:
Wall Estate Inmobiliaria exclusively presents this wonderful 102-square-meter property in the "La Guindalera" neighborhood, near Francisco Silvela and Diego de León streets.
It is a space designed as a home, featuring cross-ventilation with a very pleasant enclosed interior patio and an independent entrance from the building to the street.
Completely renovated in a modern style with plenty of natural light, it includes underfloor heating and natural gas; it consists of a kitchen integrated into the living room, a master bedroom, a full bathroom with a shower, and a half-bath, with an interior patio for the exclusive use and enjoyment of the home.
The kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator, washing machine, dishwasher, and stove.
inv.title_en: Commercial premises for sale in Guindalera
